'''Tezli Odo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on the floating [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], located in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="TJoY" /> at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Timeframe">The events of ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' took place while [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a period which started in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and ended in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Within Cloud [[City/Legends|City]], Odo ran [[The Hatchery]], a shop which sold exotic pets and various [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] animals. The shop was located on [[Market Row]], a commercial corridor in the city's [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tezli Odo was mentioned in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]]. She is listed as a merchant players can purchase goods from, but no specific interactions are listed.<ref name="TJoY" />
